description: Save a lasting rule, decision, correction or learning to store memory. Use when the user states how things should be done from now on, not for one-off requests. Duplicates change nothing; a contradiction comes back as a conflict.

note.description: The lasting rule, decision or learning to keep, written as it should apply in future work, with its conditions, exceptions and reason. Not a one-off task or a detail of the current draft.

personal.description: Save only for the person you are serving: how to work with them (language, tone, length, what to ask them). Default: shared with everyone working on this store. Never put a person's private details in shared memory.

replaces.description: The user explicitly corrected or reversed an earlier rule. Replace the old rule instead of returning a conflict.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: remember
title: Remember for this store
